adversaries.name: Arch-Necromancer
adversaries.description: A decaying mage adorned in dark, tattered robes.

features.name: Dance of Death
features.description: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage, or full damage if you spend a Fear.

features.name: Beam of Decay
features.description: Mark 2 Stress to cause all targets within Far range to make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d20+12 magic damage and you gain a Fear. Targets who succeed take half damage. A target who marks 2 or more HP must also mark 2 Stress and becomes Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

features.name: Open the Gates of Death
features.description: Spend a Fear to summon a Zombie Legion, which appears at Close range and immediately takes the spotlight.

features.name: Not Today, My Dears
features.description: When the Necromancer has marked 7 or more of their HP, you can spend a Fear to have them teleport away to a safe location to recover. A PC who succeeds on an Instinct Roll can trace the teleportation magic to their destination.

features.name: Your Life Is Mine
features.description: When the Necromancer has marked 6 or more of their HP, activate the countdown. When it triggers, deal 2d10+6 direct magic damage to a target within Close range. The Necromancer then clears a number of Stress or HP equal to the number of HP marked by the target from this attack.

adversaries.name: Cephilith Abomination
adversaries.description: A lumbering, bog-grown frog beast that has tadpolelike leeches visibly wriggling underneath their translucent skin.

features.name: Toxic Skin
features.description: A PC who comes into physical contact with the Abomination must roll a d6. On a result of 3 or lower, the PC must mark an Armor Slot or 2 HP.

features.name: Bear Hug
features.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and is Grappled until they escape with a successful Strength Roll. While Grappled, the target is Vulnerable and Restrained.

features.name: Crunch!
features.description: Spend a Fear to deal 4d12 direct physical damage to a creature Grappled by the Abomination.

features.name: Tongue Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Abomination pull a target within Far range into Melee range, then immediately spotlight the Abomination again.

features.name: Burrowing Leechpoles
features.description: When the Abomination takes Major or greater damage, their skin erupts in an explosion of subcutaneous wrigglers. Each PC within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail are covered in 2d4 leechpoles, which burrow under their skin. Until the leechpoles are dug out with a successful Finesse Roll (21), any damage the target takes gains a +1 bonus for each leechpole under their skin.

adversaries.name: Cephilith Hatchling
adversaries.description: A squidlike parasite that latches onto their prey's skull, bathing the victim's brain in extradimensional neurotoxins.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Hatchling is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Hatchling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Comatize
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Hatchling latch onto the head of a PC within Melee range. The PC must mark a Stress as the Hatchling injects the PC's brain with psycho-chemicals, and they must mark an additional Stress each time any PC fails a roll with Fear. The PC can remove the Hatchling by spending a number of Hope equal to the number of Stress they have marked. If a PC marks their last Stress while the Hatchling is latched on, the PC must make a death move. If the PC dies, you can spend a Fear to resurrect them as a Cephilith Novitiate.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight al Cephilith Hatchlings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 9 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Cephilith Novitiate
adversaries.description: A luminary of the Mortal Realm who has given their mind to extradimensional entities in exchange for eldritch abilities.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Novitiate is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Novitiate, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Cephilith Novitiates within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Sacrifice Self
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Novitiate charge at a target within Far range and melt into them. Deal 12 direct magic damage to the target and defeat the Novitiate.

adversaries.name: Cephilith Priest
adversaries.description: A perpetually moist, faceless humanoid from the Outer Realms who has elongated fingers and translucent skin, under which one can see wriggling worms.
motives_tactics: prepare this world for the Cephilith Titan's arrival

features.name: Psychic Blast
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs within Close range and force them to make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed take 2d10+5 direct magic damage. Targets who fail take 4d10+10 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

features.name: Cerebral Incursion
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a Vulnerable target within Melee range. The Priest grabs the target and inserts their elongated fingers into the target's ears, nose, and mouth. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d6 Stress, and the Priest clears an equal number of Stress.

features.name: Telekinetic Grasp
features.description: When the Priest makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can mark a Stress to Restrain the target until they spend a Hope.

adversaries.name: Cephilith Titan
adversaries.description: A transdimensional entity in the form of an impossibly large, winged humanoid with an octopus-shaped head and rows of glowing eyes.

features.name: Relentless (X)
features.description: The Titan can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X equals the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Terrifying
features.description: When the Titan makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Merely a Projection
features.description: The Titan appears in the Mortal Realm as a psychic projection approximating their true form. They have immunity to physical damage and resistance to magic damage.

features.name: Psychic Scream
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Titan unleash a mind-shattering onslaught of nightmarish visions from the Outer Realms. Each PC within Far range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (22). Targets who fail take 4d12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Summon Worshippers
features.description: Spend a Fear to summon 1d4 Cephilith Abominations, which appear within Far range, then choose one to immediately spotlight.

features.name: "It's Here..."
features.description: When the Titan has marked half their HP, they manifest in their full form, clearing all HP and losing the "Merely a Projection" feature. While the Titan is in this form, a creature who marks HP from the Titan's standard attack must mark an additional HP.

adversaries.name: Cipactli
adversaries.description: A gargantuan crocodile that has a body covered in a patchwork of fish scales, toad skin, and dozens of hungry mouths.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Cipactli can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Many Mouths
features.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Cipactli succeeds against must also mark a Stress.

features.name: Frenzied Feeding
features.description: Spend a Fear to force all PCs within Close range to succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 4d6 direct physical damage. The Cipactli clears a HP for each creature who took Severe damage from this attack.

features.name: Quaking Footfalls
features.description: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Stress and are Vulnerable until they take damage. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress.

features.name: Lifeblooded
features.description: When the Cipactli takes Severe damage, its blood splashes to the ground and instantly erupts into a jungle. All creatures within Close range are temporarily Restrained.

features.name: Verdant Explosion
features.description: When the Cipactli marks its last HP, its body erupts into dense vegetation that overtakes the landscape.

adversaries.name: Cloud Titan
adversaries.description: A devastatingly attractive, blue-skinned goliath dressed in the finest silks and dripping with jewelry. They luxuriate in the finer things and dwell in a sky palace filled with treasure.
motives_tactics: never pass up an interesting wager

features.name: Lightning Strike
features.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 4d10+14 magic damage and roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the lightning bounces, and the Titan makes this attack against a different target within Very Close range of the previous target. Each time the lightning bounces, decrease the damage it deals by 1d10.

features.name: Mist Weaver
features.description: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. The Titan conjures a thick fog over the area within Close range of that point. The Titan is Hidden to enemies within and on the other side of the fog and has advantage on attacks against creatures inside it. The fog lasts until the Titan marks HP.

features.name: Nebulous Transformation
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Titan transform into a misty cloud that fills a Very Close area. While in this form, the Titan takes double magic damage and has immunity to physical damage. This form lasts until the Titan chooses to drop out of it or takes Severe damage.

features.name: Unleash the Menagerie
features.description: Once per scene, mark any number of Stress to summon an equal number of Griffins, which appear at Close range.

features.name: Wind Worker
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Titan blast wind at a target within Close range. The target takes 4d6+8 physical damage and is pushed back to Far range from their current position.

features.name: Double or Nothing
features.description: When you would gain a Fear from an attack against the Titan, you can roll a d6. On an odd result, you don't gain the Fear. On an even result, you gain 2 Fear instead of1.

adversaries.name: Demon Lord Berzug
adversaries.description: The ruler of a deep circle in the Circles Below and a huge hybrid beast with a serpent's tail, a lizard's hind legs, a crab's claw arms, and a two-faced wolf's head.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: Berzug can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Chaos Lash
features.description: Mark a Stress to have Berzug lash at up to three PCs within Close range and force each target to make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d20 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Gaze into the Abyss
features.description: Spend a Fear to have Berzug lock eyes with a PC within Far range. The target must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or gain one of the following conditions (roll a d6 and use the corresponding result): 1-2: Mesmerized. The target immediately moves into Melee range of Berzug and is Vulnerable and Restrained until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll. 3-4: Confused. The target must mark a Stress each time they make an action roll until they clear the condition with a successful Knowledge Roll. 5-6: Enthralled. Until the PC makes a successful Presence Roll to clear the condition, you can spotlight them during a GM turn as if they were an adversary. When you do so, choose a target within Close range of the Enthralled PC. The Enthralled PC moves into Melee range of the target and makes a weapon attack against them using a d20 instead of Duality Dice.

features.name: Crushing Strike
features.description: When a PC marks HP from Berzug's standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force them to mark a number of Stress equal to the number of HP they marked. You gain a Fear.

features.name: Horrifying
features.description: When a PC fails an attack against Berzug, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Dragon Mother Mitera
adversaries.description: A gargantuan seven-headed dragon with dazzling diamond scales that shine with every color of the rinbow.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: Mitera can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight her.

features.name: Diamond Hide
features.description: Countdown (7). When Mitera first appears, activate the countdown. Mitera gains a bonus to her Difficulty equal to the countdown die's current value. It ticks down from Mitera's "Seven-Headed" feature. When the countdown triggers, Mitera becomes Vulnerable and gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls.

features.name: Elemental Breath
features.description: Mark a Stress to have Mitera unleash elemental energy from one head of your choice: 1. Fire. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d4+1 targets within Close range. Targets who take damage must mark an Armor Slot or 2 additional HP. 2. Lightning. Deal 4d12 magic damage to 1d6 targets within Far range, so long as each target beyond the first is within Close range of the previous target. 3. Acid. Each PC in front of Mitera within Close range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark 2 Armor Slots and 2 HP. Targets who succeed must mark an Armor Slot and a HP. 4. Poison. A miasma of toxic swamp gas Sickens all targets within Close range of Mitera. While Sickened, a target has disadvantage on action rolls until they mark 1d4 Stress to clear the condition. 5. Ice. Each target in front of Mitera within Close range takes 4d8+8 magic damage and is Restrained by ice until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Additionally, this area freezes over and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll to move through it. 6. Darkness. A cloud of magical shadow fills an area within Close range. Creatures inside the cloud except for Mitera are Vulnerable and have disadvantage on action rolls that rely on sight. The cloud dissipates when this Elemental Breath option is removed by Mitera's "Seven-Headed" feature. 7. Light. A beam of pure light energy deals 28 direct magic damage to each creature in a line within Very Far range.

features.name: Tail Swipe
features.description: Spend a Fear to attack all targets within Close range. Targets this attack succeeds against take 2d20+10 physical damage and are knocked back to Far range. Targets who mark HP from this attack become Vulnerable until they clear a HP. Targets this attack failed against must mark a Stress.

features.name: Fearsome
features.description: When Mitera makes a successful attack roll against a PC or a PC fails a roll within Far range, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Seven-Headed
features.description: When Mitera takes damage, roll option a d8. Permanently remove the "Elemental Breath" that corresponds to the result. On a result of 8, or if the corresponding option has already been removed, tick down the Diamond Hide countdown (see &Diamond Hide).

adversaries.name: Fallen Shock Troop
adversaries.description: A cursed soul bound to the Fallen's will.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Shock Troop is defeated when they take any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shock Troop, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Aura of Doom
features.description: When a PC marks HP from an attack by the Shock Troop, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fallen Shock Troops within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 12 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Fallen Sorcerer
adversaries.description: A powerful mage bound by the bargains they made in life.

features.name: Conflagration
features.description: Spend a Fear to unleash an all-consuming firestorm and make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Sorcerer succeeds against take 2d10+6 direct magic damage.

features.name: Nightmare Tableau
features.description: Mark a Stress to trap a target within Far range in a powerful illusion of their worst fears. While trapped, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Instinct Roll.

features.name: Slippery
features.description: When the Sorcerer takes damage from an attack, they can teleport up to Far range.

features.name: Shackles of Guilt
features.description: When the Sorcerer is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, all targets within Far range become Vulnerable and must mark a Stress as they relive their greatest regrets. A target can break free from their regret with a successful Presence or Strength Roll. When a PC fails to break free, they lose a Hope.

adversaries.name: Fallen Warlord: Realm-Breaker
adversaries.description: A Fallen God, wreathed in rage and resentment, bearing millennia of experience in breaking heroes' spirits.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Realm-Breaker can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Firespite Plate Armor
features.description: When the Realm-Breaker takes damage, reduce it by 2d10.

features.name: Tormenting Lash
features.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. When a target uses armor to reduce damage from this attack, they must mark 2 Armor Slots.

features.name: All-Consuming Rage
features.description: When the Realm-Breaker is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, create a torrent of incarnate rage that rends flesh from bone. All targets within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d6+10 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. For each HP marked from this damage, summon a Fallen Shock Troop within Very Close range of the target who marked that HP. If the countdown ever decreases its maximum value to 0, the Realm-Breaker marks their remaining HP and all targets within Far range must mark all remaining HP and make a death move.

features.name: Doombringer
features.description: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Realm-Breaker, all PCs within Far range of the target must lose a Hope.

features.name: I Have Never Known Defeat
features.description: When the Realm-Breaker marks their last HP, replace them with the Undefeated Champion and immediately spotlight them.

adversaries.name: Fallen Warlord: Undefeated Champion
adversaries.description: That which only the most feared have a chance to fear.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Undefeated Champion can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Faltering Armor
features.description: When the Undefeated Champion takes damage, reduce it by 1d10.

features.name: Shattering Strike
features.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. PCs the Champion succeeds against lose a number of Hope equal to the HP they marked from this attack.

features.name: Endless Legions
features.description: Spend a Fear to summon a number of Fallen Shock Troops equal to twice the number of PCs. The Shock Troops appear at Far range.

features.name: Circle of Defilement
features.description: When the Undefeated Champion is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, activate a magical circle covering an area within Far range of the Champion. A target within that area is Vulnerable until they leave the circle. The circle can be removed by dealing Severe damage to the Undefeated Champion.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Undefeated Champion makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Doombringer
features.description: When a target marks HP from an attack by the Undefeated Champion, all PCs within Far range of the target lose a Hope.

adversaries.name: Fire Titan Warlord
adversaries.description: A smoldering, battle-obsessed goliath wearing bespoke armor and wielding a massive maul.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Warlord can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Colossus Crafter
features.description: Countdown (6). When the Warlord enters the scene, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Warlord is spotlighted. When it triggers, summon the Gargantuan War Machine, which appears at the edge of the battlefield and immediately takes the spotlight.

features.name: Release the Hounds
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord summon two Demonic Hound Packs, which appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Spinning Strike
features.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range and gain a Fear.

features.name: Ground-Breaking
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Warlord crack the earth with a downward swing of their maul and make an attack against a group within Close range. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d10+10 direct damage. The area becomes rough terrain, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

adversaries.name: Gargantuan War Machine
adversaries.description: A 100-foot-tall adamantine construct that has gemstone eyes, powered by a chest crucible of elemental flame.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Machine can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Awesome Size
features.description: When the Machine enters the battlefield, each PC must either lose a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

features.name: Rocket Punch
features.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, the target takes 4d12+10 direct physical damage and marks 2 Armor Slots without gaining

features.name: Ground-Breaking Stomp
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a point within Close range and make an attack roll against all enemies within Close range of that point. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d12 direct physical damage and are Vulnerable until they are spotlighted. Additionally, the entire area becomes rubble, and a PC must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (16) to move through it.

features.name: Supercharged
features.description: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Machine is spotlighted for the first time, activate the countdown. It ticks down each time the Machine is spotlighted. When it triggers, place a token on this stat block as the Machine's chest crucible flares with magical flame. For each token on this stat block, the Machine gains a +1 bonus to Difficulty and attack rolls, and its standard attack deals an extra 1d12 damage. Remove a token when the Machine takes Severe damage.

adversaries.name: Ghastly Legion
adversaries.description: A teeming army of ghosts roused from dreamless slumber to fulfill their ancient oath.

features.name: Horde
features.description: When the Legion has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d6+5 magic damage instead.

features.name: Necroplasmic
features.description: The Legion is immune to physical damage and takes double magic damage.

features.name: Final Act
features.description: When the Legion is defeated, it makes a standard attack against all targets within Close range before being dispelled.

adversaries.name: Griffin
adversaries.description: A large leonine creature that has the head, talons, and wings of an eagle.

features.name: Treasure Hoarder
features.description: When a PC would mark any number of HP from the Griffin's attack, the PC can choose instead to give the Griffin an equal number of bags of gold.

features.name: Swooping Slash
features.description: Move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target along the way.

adversaries.name: Hallowed Archer
adversaries.description: Spirit soldiers with sanctified bows.

features.name: Punish the Guilty
features.description: The Archer deals double damage to targets marked Guilty by a High Seraph.

features.name: Divine Volley
features.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against up to three targets.

adversaries.name: Hallowed Choir
adversaries.description: A heavenly host of winged humanoids whose song calls forth tears of religious awe.

features.name: Horde
features.description: When the Choir has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 2d10 magic damage instead.

features.name: Celestial Coda
features.description: Countdown (Loop 3). The Choir's divine song builds on itself with each refrain. When the Choir first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when a PC gains a Hope. When it triggers, place a token on this stat block. The Choir gains a bonus to its damage rolls equal to the number of

features.name: Aural Assault
features.description: The Choir unleashes its built-up divine energy in a single burst, clearing all tokens from this stat block. Deal 1d12 direct magic damage to each enemy within Close range for each token cleared.

adversaries.name: Hallowed Soldier
adversaries.description: Souls of the faithful, lifted up with divine weaponry.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Soldier is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Soldier, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Divine Flight
features.description: While the Soldier is flying, spend a Fear to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Hallowed Soldiers within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Harbinger of Death
adversaries.description: A desiccated corpse riding atop a skeletal horse. Their eyes are sewn shut and their body is wrapped in a burial shroud of dust and ash.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Mount
features.description: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Fear the Reaper
features.description: When a creature is defeated within Far range of the Harbinger, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Decapitate
features.description: Spend 2 Fear to have the Harbinger make an attack roll against a PC within Melee range. On a success, roll a d6. On a result of 6, the target marks all HP and must make a

features.name: Wake the Fallen
features.description: Spend a Fear and mark any number of Stress to have the Harbinger resurrect a defeated ally within Far range. The resurrected ally clears a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked. Immediately spotlight the ally.

features.name: Ashes to Ashes, Dust to Dust
features.description: When the Harbinger would mark HP, you can mark a Stress to have an ally within Far range mark the HP instead.

adversaries.name: Harbinger of Famine
adversaries.description: A dried-out husk of a body riding atop a withered white horse. They are covered in mouths and surrounded by swarming flies.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Mount
features.description: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to

features.name: Hunger Pangs
features.description: Countdown (Decreasing 6). When the Harbinger appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Harbinger is spotlighted. When it triggers, all PCs within Far range mark a Stress and become Ravenous. While Ravenous, a PC can't spend Hope until they clear the condition with a successful Instinct Roll.

features.name: Drin Essence
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose up to three PCs. Each target takes 4d6 magic damage.

features.name: Too Many Mouths
features.description: Mark a Stress to attack a PC within Melee range. On a success, the Harbinger grabs the target and bites them, dealing 4d6 physical damage and Restraining the target until they break free with a successful Strength Roll.

features.name: Withering Touch
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Harbinger caress the face of a Restrained PC within Melee range. The target marks 2 Stress and either loses a Hope or marks 1d4 HP.

adversaries.name: Harbinger of Pestilence
adversaries.description: A bloated and rotting agglomeration of wriggling insects and slugs formed into a single humanoid mass riding a worm-eaten horse.

features.name: Halo of Contagion
features.description: The Harbinger is Contagious. When a PC within Very Close range of a Contagious creature takes an action, the PC rolls a d6. On a result of 1, the PC becomes Contagious. While Contagious, a PC has disadvantage on action rolls until they spend 3 Hope to clear the condition. Contagious adversaries are unaffected by the condition.

features.name: Mount
features.description: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Locust Swarm
features.description: Spend 2 Fear to have the Harbinger conjure a swarm of locusts at a point within Very Far range. Each PC within Close range of that point must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d10 direct physical damage and roll a d6. On a result of 1-2, the PC becomes Contagious.

features.name: Frog Spawn
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Harbinger conjure a clutch of diseased frogs inside the mouths of up to three PCs within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or take 4d12 magic damage and roll a d6. On a result of 1-3, the PC becomes Contagious.

features.name: Plague Bringer
features.description: Mark any number of Stress up to the number of PCs in the scene. For each Stress you mark, the Harbinger summons 1d4 Contagious Zombie Legions within Far range and immediately spotlights one of them.

adversaries.name: Harbinger of War
adversaries.description: A warrior clad in black armor and a horned helmet and bearing a bloody banner.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Harbinger can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Mount
features.description: While the Harbinger is on their mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When the Harbinger takes Severe damage, they're knocked from their mount. If the Harbinger is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Iron Dice
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Harbinger attempt a risky all-out attack. Make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, the target marks an additional HP. On a failure, the Harbinger becomes Vulnerable until they take or deal damage.

features.name: Supreme Commander
features.description: Once per scene, spend a Fear to summon 1d6 Hallowed Soldiers within Close range and immediately spotlight one of them.

features.name: Battering Ram
features.description: When a PC fails an action roll within Close range, you can spend a Fear to move into Melee range with the PC and make a standard attack with advantage against them. On a success, the PC takes standard damage and is Vulnerable until they are spotlighted.

adversaries.name: High Seraph
adversaries.description: A divine champion, head of a hallowed host of warriors who enforce their god's will.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Seraph can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Divine Flight
features.description: While the Seraph is flying, spend a Fear to move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Judgment
features.description: Spend a Fear to make a target Guilty in the eyes of the Seraph's god until the Seraph is defeated. While Guilty, the target doesn't gain Hope on a result with Hope. When the Seraph succeeds on a standard attack against a Guilty target, they deal Severe damage instead of their standard damage. The Seraph can only mark one target at a time.

features.name: God Rays
features.description: Mark a Stress to reflect a sliver of divinity as a searing beam of light that hits up to twenty targets within Very Far range. Targets must make a Presence Reaction Roll, with disadvantage if they are marked Guilty. Targets who fail take 4d6+12 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: We Are One
features.description: Once per scene, spend a Fear to spotlight all other adversaries within Far range. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

adversaries.name: Kraken
adversaries.description: A legendary beast of the sea, bigger than the largest galleon, with sucker-laden tentacles and a terrifying maw.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Kraken can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Many Tentacles
features.description: While the Kraken has 7 or fewer marked HP, they can make their standard attack against two targets within range.

features.name: Grapple and Drown
features.description: Make an attack roll against a target within Close range. On a success, mark a Stress to grab them with a tentacle and drag them beneath the water. The target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free with a successful Strength Roll or the Kraken takes Major or greater damage. While Restrained and Vulnerable in this way, a target must mark a Stress when they make an action roll.

features.name: Boiling Blast
features.description: Spend a Fear to spew a line of boiling water at any number of targets in a line up to Far range. All targets must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d6+9 physical damage. If a target marks an Armor Slot to reduce the damage, they must also mark a Stress.

features.name: Momentum
features.description: When the Kraken makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Oracle of Doom
adversaries.description: A towering immortal and incarnation of fate, cursed to only see bad outcomes.

features.name: Terrifying
features.description: When the Oracle makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Walls Closing In
features.description: When a creature rolls a failure while within Very Far range of the Oracle, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Pronounce Fate
features.description: Spend a Fear to present a target within Far range with a vision of their personal nightmare. The target must make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. On a failure, they lose all Hope and take 2d20+4 direct magic damage. On a success, they take half damage and lose a Hope.

features.name: Summon Tormentors
features.description: Once per day, spend 2 Fear to summon 2d4 Tier 2 or below Minions relevant to one of the PC's personal nightmares. They appear at Close range relative to that PC.

features.name: Ominous Knowledge
features.description: When the Oracle sees a mortal creature, they instantly know one of their personal nightmares.

features.name: Vengeful Fate
features.description: When the Oracle marks HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can mark a Stress to knock the attacker back to Far range and deal 2d10+4 physical damage.

adversaries.name: Outer Realms Abomination
adversaries.description: A chaotic mockery of life, constantly in flux.

features.name: Chaotic Form
features.description: When the Abomination attacks, roll 2d4 and use the result as their attack modifier.

features.name: Disorienting Presence
features.description: When a target takes damage from the Abomination, they must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they gain disadvantage on their next action roll and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Reality Quake
features.description: Spend a Fear to rattle the edges of reality within Far range of the Abomination. All targets within that area must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or become Unstuck from reality until the end of the scene. When an Unstuck target spends Hope or marks Armor Slots, HP, or Stress, they must double the amount spent or marked.

features.name: Unreal Form
features.description: When the Abomination takes damage, reduce it by 1d20. If the Abomination marks 1 or fewer Hit Points from a successful attack against them, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Outer Realms Corrupter
adversaries.description: A shifting, formless mass seemingly made of chromatic light.

features.name: Will-Shattering Touch
features.description: When a PC takes damage from the Corrupter, they lose a Hope.

features.name: Disgorge Reality Flotsam
features.description: Mark a Stress to spew partially digested portions of consumed realities at all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or mark 2 Stress.

adversaries.name: Outer Realms Thrall
adversaries.description: A vaguely humanoid form stripped of memory and identity.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Thrall is defeated when they take any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Thrall, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Outer Realm Thralls within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Owl Witch
adversaries.description: A giant, vengeful barn owl that has a 15-foot wingspan and a human face.

features.name: III Omen
features.description: When a PC within Close range makes an action roll, their Fear Die gains a bonus equal to the amount of Fear you have.

features.name: Witch Barrier
features.description: The Owl Witch has resistance to magic damage.

features.name: Voice Mimicry
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Owl Witch beckon with the voice of a beloved figure to a creature within earshot. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or move up to Far range toward the Owl Witch.

features.name: Nightmare Stare
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Owl Witch Afflict a PC within Far range with waking nightmares unless the target succeeds on a Knowledge Reaction Roll. While Afflicted, the target can't clear HP or Stress. The condition is cleared when another PC uses a downtime move to comfort the Afflicted

features.name: Visions of a Violent End
features.description: When the Owl Witch is targeted by an attack, you can spend a Fear to force the attacker to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must mark 1d4 Stress as their mind is flooded with harrowing imagery.

adversaries.name: Perfected Zombie
adversaries.description: A towering, muscular zombie with magically infused strength and skill.

features.name: Terrifying
features.description: When the Zombie makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Fearsome Presence
features.description: PCs can't spend Hope to use features against the Zombie.

features.name: Perfect Strike
features.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Zombie succeeds against are Vulnerable until their next rest.

features.name: Skilled Opportunist
features.description: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Very Close range of the Zombie, you can spend a Fear to add the Zombie's standard attack damage to the damage roll.

adversaries.name: Ruby Dragon
adversaries.description: A huge winged dragon that has visible flames beneath its glittering, gem-encrusted scales. Its body heat melts stone

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Dragon can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Fearsome
features.description: When the Dragon succeeds on an attack against a PC or a PC within Far range fails an action roll, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Melting Breath
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Dragon unleash a blast of fire on all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d12+10 magic damage and mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Volcanic Fissure
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Dragon snap its tail against the ground, opening a lava rift that flows over the area within Close range. Each PC within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed immediately move out of the area. Targets who fail take 4d8+5 magic damage. Until the Dragon is defeated, a creature who enters the area takes 4d8+5 magic damage.

features.name: Hot-Blooded
features.description: When a creature makes a successful attack against the Dragon within Very Close range, the Dragon's blood erupts from the wound and burns the attacker, forcing them to mark an Armor Slot. If they can't mark an Armor Slot, they mark 1d4 HP.

adversaries.name: Severed Shadow
adversaries.description: A two-dimensional living shadow bound to flat planes and surfaces.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Shadow is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 12 damage a PC deals to the Shadow, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range that the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Shadow Grapple
features.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the target becomes Vulnerable and must mark a Stress when they take an action until the Shadow is defeated.

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Severed Shadows within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 10 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Supreme Demiurge Adonix
adversaries.description: The four-faced angel from the Hallows Above who manifests in the Mortal Realm as a floating tetrahedron with numerous eyes and multiple sets of metallic feathered wings.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: Adonix can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Elemental Archon
features.description: Mark a Stress to roll a d4. Adonix activates the corresponding effect: 1. Fire Beam. Adonix manifests a beam of elemental fire with a Very Close width from themself to the edge of the battlefield Each target in the beam's path must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take Severe damage. Targets who succeed take Minor damage. 2. Thunderclap. All creatures within Far range must mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until they succeed on an attack roll or the Demiurge is defeated. 3. Lightning Bolt. Make an attack against a target within Very Far range, dealing 4d8 magic damage on a success. If all results are even, make the same attack against a different target, repeating the cycle until you roll an odd result or run 4. Ice Storm. Each PC within Close range must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark 1d4 Stress and become Restrained until they spend a Hope to escape.

features.name: Alpha to Omega
features.description: When Adonix is defeated, they resurrect in Omega form with all HP and Stress cleared. Each PC within Very Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or lose a Hope. You gain a Fear for each Hope lost in this way. Adonix gains the following features in this form: Forsaken - Action: Spend a Fear to choose a PC and activate a Forsaken Countdown (1d8) for them. It ticks down when Adonix is spotlighted. When it triggers, the PC must mark all their HP. The countdown ends if Adonix takes Severe damage. You can have only one Forsaken Countdown active at a time. Armageddon - Reaction: When Adonix is defeated again, they unleash a reality storm that shakes the realms to their foundations. Roll a d6. On a result of 5-6, each PC must make

adversaries.name: Temporal Enforcer
adversaries.description: A giant mechanical being from a dimension outside time, built by the Time Keepers to preserve the Holy Continuum.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Enforcer can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Time Looper
features.description: Countdown (Loop 2d6). When the Enforcer first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Enforcer is spotlighted. When it triggers, the Enforcer clears all HP, Stress, and conditions. Reroll the countdown when the Enforcer takes Severe damage.

features.name: Move Between Moments
features.description: Mark a Stress to have the Enforcer teleport to a point within Very Far range, then spotlight

features.name: Instant Rewind
features.description: When the Enforcer fails an attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the die.

features.name: Invert Polrity
features.description: Up to three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to flip any die rolled onto its obverse result. This effect can't be used to alter a critical success.

adversaries.name: Volcanic Dragon: Ashen Tyrant
adversaries.description: No enemy has ever had the insolence to wound the dragon so. As the lava settles, it's ground to ash like the dragon's past foes.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Ashen Tyrant can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cornered
features.description: Mark a Stress instead of spending a Fear to spotlight the Ashen Tyrant.

features.name: Injured Wings
features.description: While flying, the Ashen Tyrant gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Ashes to Ashes
features.description: When a PC rolls a failure while within Close range of the Ashen Tyrant, they lose a Hope and you gain a Fear. If the PC can't lose a Hope, they must mark a HP.

features.name: Desperate Rampage
features.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Ashen Tyrant succeeds against take 2d20+2 physical damage, are knocked back to Close range of where they were, and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Ashen Cloud
features.description: Spend a Fear to smash the ground and kick up ash within Far range. While within the ash cloud, a target has disadvantage on action rolls. The ash cloud clears the next time an adversary is spotlighted.

features.name: Apocalyptic Thrashing
features.description: Spend a Fear to activate. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the Ashen Tyrant thrashes about, causing environmental damage (such as an earthquake, avalanche, or collapsing walls). All targets within Far range must make a Strength Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10+10 physical damage and are Restrained by the rubble until they break free with a successful Strength Roll. Targets who succeed take half damage. If the Ashen Tyrant is defeated while this countdown is active, trigger the countdown immediately as the destruction caused by their death throes.

adversaries.name: Volcanic Dragon: Molten Scourge
adversaries.description: Enraged by their wounds, the dragon bursts into molten lava.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Molten Scourge can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Cracked Scales
features.description: When the Molten Scourge takes damage, roll a number of d6s equal to HP marked. For each result of 4 or higher, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Shattering Might
features.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, the target takes 4d8+1 physical damage, loses a Hope, and is knocked back to Close range. The Molten Scourge clears a Stress.

features.name: Eruption
features.description: Spend a Fear to erupt lava from beneath the Molten Scourge's scales, filling the area within Very Close range with molten lava. All targets in that area must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d6+6 physical damage and be knocked back to Close range. This area remains lava. When a creature other than the Molten Scourge enters that area or acts while inside of it, they must mark 6 HP.

features.name: Volcanic Breath
features.description: When the Molten Scourge takes Major damage, roll a d10. On a result of 8 or higher, the Molten Scourge breathes a flow of lava in front of them within Far range. All targets in that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d10+4 physical damage, mark 1d4 Stress, and are Vulnerable until they clear a Stress. Targets who succeed take half damage and must mark a Stress.

features.name: Lava Splash
features.description: When the Molten Scourge takes Severe damage from an attack within Very Close range, molten blood gushes from the wound and deals 2d10+4 direct physical damage to the attacker.

features.name: Ashen Vengeance
features.description: When the Molten Scourge marks their last HP, replace them with the Ashen Tyrant and immediately spotlight them.

adversaries.name: Volcanic Dragon: Obsidian Predator
adversaries.description: A massive winged creature with obsidian scales and impossibly sharp claws.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Obsidian Predator can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Flying
features.description: While flying, the Obsidian Predator gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Obsidian Scales
features.description: The Obsidian Predator is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Avalanche Tail
features.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take 4d6+4 physical damage and are knocked back to Far range and Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope.

features.name: Dive-Bomb
features.description: If the Obsidian Predator is flying, mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range. Move to that point and make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Obsidian Predator succeeds against take 2d10+6 physical damage and must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

features.name: Erupting Rage
features.description: When the Obsidian Predator marks their last HP, replace them with the Molten Scourge and immediately spotlight them.

adversaries.name: Water Mother
adversaries.description: A colossal fur-covered snake that hunts in large bodies of water.

features.name: Segmented
features.description: The Water Mother's body is divided into three segments: Head, Center, and Tail. The Water Mother always moves from the Head first, pulling the Center and then Tail behind it. A creature can target the Water Mother with an attack as long as at least one of her segments is within range, but the Water Mother can make a standard attack only against a target within range of her Head. If an attack deals damage to the Water Mother and her Head is within range, the attack deals an extra 1d10 damage.

features.name: Eat the World
features.description: Spend a Fear to have the Water Mother inhale sharply. Each PC within Close range of her Head must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and be pulled within Melee range of the Head. The Water Mother then makes a standard attack against all targets within Melee range

features.name: Constrict
features.description: Mark a Stress to make an attack against all targets within Melee range of the Center segment. Targets the attack succeeds against take 4d8+8 physical damage and are temporarily Restrained. At the beginning of each GM turn, you can mark a Stress to force all targets Restrained by the Water

features.name: Venom Surge
features.description: When the Water Mother makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Vulnerable until the end of the scene.

adversaries.name: Wyrmfiend
adversaries.description: A reptilian biped created by mysterious and ancient dragon magic. Wyrmfiends exist more as extensions of their draconic master's will than as individual beings.

features.name: Minion
features.description: The Wyrmfiend is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 13 damage a PC deals to the Wyrmfiend, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Venomous Bite
features.description: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a PC within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d4+4 physical damage and Poison the target until they succeed on a Strength Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, the target must

features.name: Group Attack
features.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Wyrmfiends within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 11 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Wyrmlings
adversaries.description: A clutch of newly hatched dragons. As newborns, they're furious, hungry, and stupid.

features.name: Horde
features.description: When the Wyrmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead.

features.name: Ravenous
features.description: Once per GM turn when a PC marks a HP from an attack made by the Wyrmlings, you can spend a Fear to spotlight the Wyrmlings again.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.description: When the Wyrmlings take Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.

adversaries.name: Xero the Castle Killer
adversaries.description: A castle-sized, bipedal reptile.

features.name: Relentless (X)
features.description: Xero can be spotlighted up to X times per GM turn, where X is the number of PCs in the scene. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Collateral Damage
features.description: Xero's movement can't be hindered, impeded, or affected by anything other than natural terrain. All destructible terrain or obstacles in Xero's path are destroyed when Xero moves through them.

features.name: Gigaton Stomp
features.description: Spend a Fear to have Xero bring its foot down hard, creating a localized earthquake. Each PC within Melee range takes 4d12 physical damage and is Restrained until they wriggle out with a successful Finesse Roll. Each creature beyond Melee range but within Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be knocked back to Far range. If a target is knocked back, they must either mark an Armor Slot or take 4d12 physical damage as they land.

features.name: Power Slide
features.description: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range. Each PC Xero moves through must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or choose to either mark 2 Armor Slots or take Severe damage.

features.name: Radioactive Breath
features.description: Spend a Fear to have Xero charge up a nuclear beam. Place a token on this stat block. The next time Xero is spotlighted, you can spend this token and unleash a beam to Very Far range. The beam has a width of Close range. Each PC in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d12+12 direct magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage. Xero can't use this feature again until it takes Severe damage.

features.name: Regenertion
features.description: Up to three times per scene, spend any number of Fear to clear an equal number of HP.

adversaries.name: Zombie Legion
adversaries.description: A large pack of undead, still powerful despite their rotting flesh.

features.name: Horde
features.description: When the Legion has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead.

features.name: Unyielding
features.description: The Legion has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: The Legion can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.description: When the Legion takes Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.
